decisions.quote: For the UNC sample, free recall scores and the amount of category clustering (a measure of organizational processing) was greater in the restudy than retrieval condition (i.e., the negative testing effect was found); for the KSU sample, there was no difference on either measure.
decisions.reason: The study tested the negative-testing paradigm across two samples with conflicting results—replicating the negative testing effect in the UNC sample while finding no difference on either measure in the KSU sample—which the authors describe as a 'varying outcome' showing the effect is replicable only in certain participant populations.
